quote.translation: In short, positive contingency, whether positive contingency of ground, positive teleological contingency or positive causal contingency, possesses both positivity and relativity.

regions.text: 然るにここに注意すべきことはいづれの滑極約絶謝的偶然も結局はその機祇に積極約相對約偶然を有つてあるといふことである。

quote.translation: What we must note here, however, is that every negative absolute contingency has, in the end, a positive relative contingency at its root.

regions.text: いつたい、相勤偶然は假說的開係を映くといふ滑極的方面と、假説約醐係以外に何箏かの關係が成立するといふ積極方面とを有つてるる。

quote.translation: Relative contingency in general has a negative aspect, the lack of a hypothetical relation, and a positive aspect, the holding of some relation other than a hypothetical one.

regions.text: 謂はゆる滑極的偶然とはその滑極的方面のみを目撃した場合をいひ、積極約偶然とは更に進んで積極約方面をも合せて目撃した場合をいふのである。

quote.translation: So-called negative contingency is the case in which only the negative aspect is witnessed, whilst positive contingency is the case in which we go further and witness the positive aspect along with it.

regions.text: 然しながらその實機極約方面を全く餃いた偶然といふものはあり得ないのでたとへ意識前に積極方面が把握されてるないでも何等かそこに積極性がなければならないのである。

quote.translation: Yet since the contingent wholly lacking the positive aspect cannot in reality exist, there must be some positivity present even when the positive aspect is not consciously grasped.

regions.text: その積極性は残は他の次元に於て目撃されるべき姓質のものであるかも知れないが、いっれにしてもぞこには何等かの積極性が目撃されなければ異の偶然とは云へないのである。

quote.translation: That positivity may be of a kind to be witnessed in some other dimension, but in any case, unless some positivity is witnessed, we cannot speak of the true contingent.

regions.text: その意味ですべての偶然は積極的相對的偶然であるといふことが出來る。

quote.translation: In this sense we can say that all the contingent is positive relative contingency.

regions.text: 例へば理由消極偶然の根概には理由的積極的偶然が落んでゐる。

quote.translation: Positive contingency of ground, for example, lies hidden at the root of negative contingency of ground.
Earlier we gave as an example of negative contingency the case of "falling by chance into the truth" without any ground.
